question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Belongings**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Belongings **refer to a person's possessions or property. (किसी व्यक्ति की संपत्ति या सम्पत्ति)

 
 
• **For example**: *She packed her belongings before moving to a new apartment.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The word is a noun and is used to describe things that someone owns or has with them.
 
• The sentence might be referring to someone who is hesitant to part with their belongings.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inhibitions **refer to feelings of self-consciousness or restraint. (आत्म-चेतना या संयम की भावनाएँ)
 
• **Experiences **refer to events or occurrences that someone has gone through. (घटनाएँ या घटनाएँ जिनसे कोई गुज़रा हो)
 
• **Antiques **refer to old or rare objects that are considered valuable or collectable. (पुरानी या दुर्लभ वस्तुएँ जिन्हें मूल्यवान या संग्रहणीय माना जाता है)
